_doc.purpose: Editable assumptions for the full-run projection in cost/report.md. Measured pilot numbers never come from this file. Change a value here (or pass --set key=value) and re-run `python3 cost/cost_calc.py`.
_doc.budget_usd: Declared API budget for the full run. PLACEHOLDER: Hanif must confirm before the full run. The report shows a warning when a scenario exceeds it or cannot be checked because items are unknown.
_doc.pilot_budget_usd: Spend cap for the cold+warm 100-review pilot (src/labelling/pilot_config.json limits.spend_cap_usd).
_doc.output_token_cap: Declared max output tokens per call, by role. null = no cap declared (shown as unknown). Keep these equal to max_tokens in the run config. The report flags any observed call above the cap.
_doc.max_concurrency: Maximum workers for the full run. The pilot uses 1 worker. Projected time divides per-worker throughput by this (times concurrency_efficiency).
_doc.max_fallback_fraction: Declared hard cap on the fraction of enrich work routed to a stronger fallback model. 0.0 = no fallback model (pilot_config.json limits.max_fallback_fraction).
_doc.fallback_fraction: Assumed fallback fraction per scenario. Must not exceed max_fallback_fraction (the report warns if it does).
_doc.verify_sample_fraction: Declared verification sample fraction of non-cached completed records for the full-run projection (0.05, coordinator decision 2026-10-06; the pilot config uses 0.1 on 100 rows).
_doc.verify_max_items: Cap on verified items in the full run (2000, coordinator decision 2026-10-06).
_doc.retry_rate: Fraction of billed work assumed to be re-sent (retries that are charged). The report also shows the measured pilot retry rate.
_doc.fixed_overhead_multiplier: Multiplier on the measured one-time group+memo cost. Counted once, never per row.
_doc.concurrency_efficiency: Fraction of linear speed-up achieved per extra worker (rate limits, contention).
_doc.reasoning_tokens_included_in_output: true = provider's output_tokens already include reasoning tokens, so reasoning is not billed again. false = reasoning tokens are billed as a separate 'reasoning' item.
_doc.projection: Full-corpus work counts from docs/specs/manifest.json and AGENTS.md.
_doc.prepilot_estimate: Used ONLY while no measured pilot exists, and labelled PRE-PILOT ESTIMATE in the report.
_doc.batch_api_estimate: Hypothetical Batch API discount for eligible chat roles. Appears only as an estimated scenario line in section 2.

prepilot_estimate.source: src/labelling/PREP.md (Jev cost paragraph): about 500-600 input tokens per review at larger packs; Jev output is free.

batch_api_estimate.note: ESTIMATE ONLY. Anthropic Batch API price = 50% of standard. Shown as a separate estimated line; never applied to the measured bill. Only roles that could tolerate batch latency are listed (verify); Jev enrich is not eligible.
